rules.title: Verifier NAV vs EVM cash + Core API equity
rules.rationale: Onchain NAV (read precompiles over the registered scope) must match an independent API view; a gap means unregistered holdings, a stale read or a valuation bug.
rules.action: Pause deposits (owner) and inspect scope / unregistered holdings before the next allocation.

rules.title: EVM USDC balance covers accounted cash + claim reserve
rules.rationale: A shortfall means the Vault's books exceed its real ERC-20 balance.

rules.title: Core holdings outside the registered scope
rules.rationale: Holdings outside the scope are invisible to NAV and can dilute depositors (scope completeness is owner-trusted).
rules.action: Register the venue via source.configure or bring the holding back into scope.

rules.title: Core account abstraction mode
rules.rationale: Margin behaviour and borrowing depend on the mode; PM falls back when ineligible or caps hit.
rules.action: If unexpected, stop new expansion; confirm the CoreWriter action and eligibility.

rules.title: USDC borrow and borrow APR
rules.rationale: Borrow cost above funding makes the carry negative. Borrowing is automatic in PM and manual (borrowLend, API wallet) in Standard/Unified; both are expected paths.
rules.action: Stop expansion; reduce the extra leg if borrow APR exceeds funding.

rules.title: Borrow health: borrowed vs supplied collateral
rules.threshold: liquidation usage warn >= 0.70, alert >= 0.85 (or health factor < 1.05)
rules.rationale: Partial liquidation starts when borrowed value exceeds collateral x (1+LTV)/2 (HYPE 82.5%, BTC 75%). Health factor < 100% only stops new borrows. Price falls, interest and withdrawals move it.
rules.action: Repay USDC or supply more collateral (API wallet borrowLend); stop new borrows.

rules.title: Funding on the hedge perp (now, 24h and 7d average)
rules.threshold: warn: 24h avg < 0 while short; alert: 7d avg < 0 while short
rules.rationale: Shorts pay when funding is negative; a negative 7-day average means the carry has inverted, not a blip (HYPE 90d: ~9% of hours negative).
rules.action: 24h negative: stop adding. 7d negative: unwind the hedge leg (strategy --unwind) or park in USDC.

rules.title: Hedge delta |spot - short| x mark
rules.rationale: Unhedged size is directional exposure the product does not intend.
rules.action: Rebalance with the strategy runner (dry-run first).

rules.title: Pending Core action age
rules.rationale: Core actions are asynchronous; a pending action closes deposits and blocks the next owner action.
rules.action: Run sync after a later Core block; for a recall that never arrives, abandonRecall + timeout.

rules.title: Gas: owner EVM HYPE and Vault Core HYPE (Core->EVM transfer gas)
rules.rationale: Without gas the owner cannot sync/recall; Core->EVM transfers pay 200k gas in HYPE on Core.
rules.action: Top up the owner; keep a HYPE reserve on the Vault's Core spot.

rules.title: Maintenance margin / collateral (Unified: USDC balance + uPnL)
rules.rationale: Liquidation at 1.0. In Unified mode the perp DEX account value is only the margin assigned to the position; the collateral is the whole USDC balance, so the ratio uses it.
rules.action: Reduce the hedge or add USDC margin.

rules.title: Latest share-price record age
rules.rationale: Deposits and exit settlement require recent price history (half a window).

rules.title: Free EVM cash vs target buffer
rules.rationale: Free cash is the only liquidity outside Core; the vault does not enforce a buffer (owner policy).
rules.action: Allocate less, or recall to restore the buffer before more requests arrive.

rules.title: Oldest unsettled redeem request in the open epoch
rules.rationale: Active redemptions are paid only after the owner exits; the published commitment is settlement within 72 hours of a request.
rules.action: Owner: beginExit, unwind, recall and settle the epoch.

rules.title: Redeem queue: reserved claims covered by cash
rules.rationale: Settled claims must be payable from EVM cash.
rules.action: Owner must recall before claims can be paid.

ai.summary: 13 of 15 rules are ok, no rule is unobservable, and NAV reconciles within tolerance (nav-ledger diff +0.1538 USDC). Two rules need attention: delta is in alert (hedge |spot - short| x mark = 56.92 USD against a limit of 2, with spot +0.0 and short 0.68), and gas is in warn (Vault Core HYPE 0.0 against a minimum of 0.002).
causes: delta: the perp short (0.68) has no matching spot leg (0.0), so the hedge is one-sided. Likely the spot position was reduced or never fully established while the short remained, and no rebalance has run since.

gas: Vault Core HYPE is 0.0, below the 0.002 minimum, so no HYPE reserve is held on the Vault's Core spot balance. Core->EVM transfers need that HYPE for gas. The owner EVM balance (0.0297) is above its 0.02 floor, so the gap is the Core-side reserve, not the owner wallet.
ai.impact: Depositors carry directional exposure on the unhedged ~56.92 USD, which the product does not intend. Accounting still reconciles, but with no HYPE on Core the owner may be unable to complete Core->EVM transfers or recalls until the reserve is topped up.
responseCandidates: delta: run the strategy rebalance in dry-run first, then apply it to bring spot and short back in line.
gas: top up the Vault's Core spot with HYPE to at least 0.002 and keep a standing reserve.
gas: keep the owner EVM HYPE at or above 0.02 (currently 0.0297 and passing).
